info.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued September 26 at 2:50PM EDT until September 27 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Baltimore MD/Washington DC
info.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, up to two feet of inundation above ground level in low lying areas due to tidal flooding. For the Coastal Flood Warning, up to two and a half feet of inundation above ground level expected in low lying areas due to tidal flooding.
* WHERE...Shoreline in St. Marys County.
* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 11 PM EDT this evening, especially around the time of high tide. For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 11 PM this evening to 6 PM EDT Sunday, especially around the time of high tide.
* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, water covers roads on Saint George Island, is in yards, and is approaching structures. To the east, inundation is occurring at multiple marinas off St. Mary's River, Smith Creek, and Jutland Creek.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Tides two and a half to three feet above normal. The next high tide at Piney Point is at 3:07 AM and 3:19 PM. The next high tide at Coltons Point is at 3:19 PM and 3:43 AM. The next high tide at Point Lookout is at 1:55 AM and 2:36 PM.
info.instruction: Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.
